about: The settings corners check:rendered:corners runs, one after another, light and dark (scripts/rendered/corners.mjs). Each corner's assert-rule baseline is known-failures/<id>.json; defaults keep known-failures.json and the snapshots. `fast` is the family subset for routine runs and CI: overlays, marks, rows and controls. Values are the registry's (packages/tokens config); an unknown one fails before a browser opens.

corners.about: Thickest line, strongest edges, bold focus ring, thickest selected edge
No line, no edge contrast, no floating shadow
Greyest light page with flat layers; greyest dark page with the farthest layers
Accent buttons and selection, 30% strength, yellow
Lowest tone contrast, richest tone tints
